title: Building Shelters
description: Learn the mkdir command to create directories

story: 👩 Ruth: "This says you can make something using the word 'mkdir'?"
Try making an igloo using 'mkdir igloo'.
💡 NEW POWER: 'mkdir' followed by a word lets you create a shelter
hints: Create an igloo structure by using 'mkdir igloo'

story: Now have a look around and see what's changed.
steps.objective: Look around to see the new igloo
